item.title: [8] Strongly Enhanced Charge-Density Waves and Correlated Insulating State in Atomically Thin 1T−TaS2
item.description:
Last authors: Yi Lu, Xiaoxiang Xi

Authors: Gan Liu, Yulu Liu, Qiling Luo, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental investigation of CDW and correlated states in a relevant thin-film TMD.

Tags: #experiment #CDW #TMD

Abstract: A combination of Raman spectroscopy and transport measurements shows that approaching the 2D limit markedly enhances the charge density wave order and the associated correlated insulating state in 1 T -TaS 2 .
